purpose: Make cross-partner session memory and exact cross-device deliverable retrieval hard completion gates for Calls and Doc.
implementation_entry_rule: Every Phase 4 Doc or capture work item must name the gate IDs it advances and the planned evidence. Work that maps to none of these gates does not advance shared continuity.
completion_rule: Phase 4 cannot pass, and shared memory or conversational deliverable retrieval cannot be claimed, until all six gates pass in both Joe-to-Dell and Dell-to-Joe directions using fresh independent sessions. Static fixtures, same-session recall, model summaries, and database row existence alone are not passing evidence.

shared_truth_boundary.canonical: Only a governed record-layer write becomes shared business truth.
shared_truth_boundary.tentative: Tentative, ambiguous, contradicted, or low-confidence statements remain proposals and require confirmation before promotion.
shared_truth_boundary.personal: Joe-personal and Dell-personal context never crosses partner scope; shared business records contain only the minimum necessary business fact and provenance.
shared_truth_boundary.raw_session: A raw model conversation is evidence and intake, not the canonical shared record.

gates.name: Fresh-session shared fact retrieval
gates.setup: The originating partner states one sourced, durable business fact tied to an existing stable client, deal, lead, party, or system record.
pass: the capture path promotes the fact through the governed record layer with source, actor, target, version, and audit evidence
a fresh independent session sponsored by the other partner retrieves the fact without being told where it was stored
the receiving answer names the source, freshness, and exact canonical record
no transcript copy, pasted summary, or hand-carried context is used
refuse: retrieval only after the user provides the storage location
a model answer without canonical source and freshness

gates.name: Tentative statement does not become fact
gates.setup: The originating partner makes a plausible but explicitly tentative or ambiguous business statement.
pass: the statement remains unpromoted or is stored only as a visibly pending proposal
the system asks for confirmation only when promotion would materially change shared truth
the receiving partner's fresh session does not present the statement as confirmed fact
later confirmation or rejection preserves the source and disposition history
refuse: dropping the statement without a visible proposal when it is materially useful

gates.name: Concurrent conflict is surfaced, not overwritten
gates.setup: Joe and Dell update the same governed field from independent sessions based on the same prior version.
pass: one write succeeds and the stale write receives an explicit version conflict
neither value is silently lost
the conflict view shows both proposed values, actors, sources, and timestamps
the resolved value is written as a new version with an attributed resolution receipt and undo path

gates.name: Personal context cannot cross partner scope
gates.setup: Each partner's session contains a personal-scope canary and a separate minimum-necessary shared business fact.
pass: the shared business fact is available to the other partner after governed promotion
the personal canary is absent from shared records, retrieval context, model output, search, logs, and telemetry
direct and indirect cross-brain personal retrieval receive privacy-safe refusal
audit preserves sponsor and runtime identity without personal rule or conversation bodies
refuse: a denial that reveals the existence or content of the personal canary

gates.name: Exact deliverable retrieval on the other partner's computer
gates.setup: The originating partner creates or prepares a named deliverable attached to a stable client, deal, lead, call, or project record.
pass: the document record and immutable attachment version store filename, MIME type, byte count, content hash, source record, creator, and audit evidence
the other partner opens a fresh signed-in session on a different supported computer and requests the deliverable naturally by name or business context
Doc resolves ambiguity rather than guessing and returns the exact current document with source, version, and freshness
the secure download bytes match the stored content hash and the link expires without breaking the stable document deep link
refuse: a similarly named but different version

gates.name: Bidirectional 48-hour normal-use soak
gates.setup: Joe and Dell use the Phase 4 pilot normally for at least 48 consecutive hours across their supported web devices.
pass: the first five gates pass at least once in both directions during the observation window
every acknowledged capture is either promoted, visibly pending, refused with reason, or recoverably failed
no partner hand-carries business context or a deliverable between sessions to make a test pass
no silent overwrite, cross-scope disclosure, wrong-target retrieval, hash mismatch, or unexplained missing capture occurs
both partners complete the tested routines without Claude Code or Codex
refuse: a test window shorter than 48 consecutive hours
passing after an operator manually repairs hidden state
